claims.evidence: Seller's own later statement says 'direct from Belgium', contradicting 'Direct Japan' in the same listing; photo shows no origin markings, stickers, or paperwork.
No shipping tag, chassis plate, customs sticker, or paperwork visible in the photo to confirm import origin.
No start-up video, no diagnostic screen, no running clip provided; photo only shows a static, removed engine.
Requires audio/video of engine running; a still photo cannot show or disprove engine noise.
No odometer, ECU readout, or service history visible; mileage cannot be read from an external engine photo.
Valve cover and housings show grime but no visible tamper seals or fresh gasket marks to confirm originality; would need close-up of bolt heads/seals.

risks.risk: Internal contradiction in seller's own claims (Japan vs Belgium origin) suggests copy-pasted or dishonest listing text
risks.proof: Seller must clarify and show matching import/customs documents or chassis/engine ID plate
risks.if_unproven: treat listing as high-risk/unreliable, price at worst case pending clarification

risks.risk: Unknown mechanical condition (compression, knocking, oil leaks)
risks.proof: Video of cold start-up with audio, plus compression test reading
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-verified running condition, i.e. worst case (possible non-runner)

risks.risk: Incompleteness of engine (missing starter, alternator, ECU, loom, mounts)
risks.proof: Full 360° photo set and itemized parts list
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare long block only, excluding ancillary parts

risks.risk: Unknown make/model/displacement affects part compatibility and value
risks.proof: Clear photo of engine ID stamp or VIN tag from donor vehicle
risks.if_unproven: cannot assign model-specific price tier; priced at generic used engine floor rate

risks.risk: Reason for removal unknown (could be accident or fault-related)
risks.proof: Photo of donor vehicle or accident report/bill of sale
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming possible fault-related removal (worst case)

risks.risk: Guarantee legitimacy (2 months) unverifiable from a stranger
risks.proof: Written guarantee document with seller ID/contact and terms
risks.if_unproven: treated as no guarantee for pricing purposes

proof_requests: Clarify true origin (Japan or Belgium) with matching import/customs paperwork or chassis plate photo
Video of engine cold-starting and idling with audible sound
Photo of engine ID/stamp number and full 360° views including underside
Itemized list/photos of included ancillary parts (ECU, loom, mounts, starter, alternator)
Odometer or ECU mileage readout if available from donor vehicle
Close-up of bolts/seals on valve cover and housings to support 'never opened' claim
response.reason: The seller's own words contradict themselves on the engine's country of origin (Japan vs Belgium), a classic sign of a copy-pasted or deceptive listing, and none of the performance or authenticity claims are supported by the photo evidence.
